items.source: UnsupportedOperationException - if invoked during AOT run-time execution
items.translation: UnsupportedOperationException - 如果在 AOT 运行时执行 期间调用

items.source:
In general, users should take care to prevent overlaps with other
metadata attributes by using fully-qualified names, perhaps using a
class or package name as a prefix.
items.translation: 通常，用户应通过使用完全限定名称（例如使用类或包名作为前缀）来防止与其他元数据属性发生重叠。

items.source: An AotContextLoader would typically contribute an attribute in loadContextForAotProcessing(); whereas, an AotTestExecutionListener would typically contribute an attribute in processAheadOfTime(). Any other test component — such as a TestContextBootstrapper — can choose to contribute an attribute at any point in time. Note that contributing an attribute during standard JVM test execution will not have any adverse side effect since AOT attributes will be ignored in that scenario. In any case, you should use AotDetector.useGeneratedArtifacts() to determine if invocations of setAttribute(String, String) and removeAttribute(String) are permitted.
items.translation: `AotContextLoader` 接口通常会在 ``loadContextForAotProcessing()` 方法中贡献一个属性；而 `AotTestExecutionListener` 接口通常会在 ``processAheadOfTime()` 方法中贡献一个属性。任何其他测试组件（例如 ``TestContextBootstrapper`）都可以在任意时间点选择贡献一个属性。请注意，在标准 JVM 测试执行期间贡献属性不会产生任何不利影响，因为在这种情况下会忽略 AOT 属性。无论如何，您都应使用 ``AotDetector.useGeneratedArtifacts()` 来确定是否允许调用 ``setAttribute(String, String)` 和 ``removeAttribute(String)`。

items.source: AOT test attributes are supported in two modes of operation: build-time and run-time. At build time, test components can contribute attributes during the AOT processing phase. At run time, test components can retrieve attributes that were contributed at build time. If AotDetector.useGeneratedArtifacts() returns true, run-time mode applies.
items.translation: AOT 测试属性支持两种运行模式：构建时和运行时。在构建时，测试组件可以在 AOT 处理阶段贡献属性。在运行时，测试组件可以检索**

items.source: See the class-level Javadoc for details on the two supported modes.
items.translation: 有关两种支持模式的详细信息，请参阅类级别的Javadoc。

items.source:
For example, if a test component computes something at build time that
cannot be computed at run time, the result of the build-time computation can
be stored as an AOT attribute and retrieved at run time without repeating the
computation.
items.translation: 例如，如果测试组件在构建时计算了无法在运行时计算的内容，则可以将构建时计算的结果存储为 AOT 属性，并在运行时检索该结果而无需重复计算。
